text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
Haaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: (Craft...! She's so much—faster than last time...!!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, my heart is burning...!
You shine like light itself... and I want to pass you!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(You really know how to...
get me all fired up, don't you...?!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
But! I'm not—
the same girl I used to be!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaaa~~!!
Heart, you were seriously so cool~~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! That girl was great! The one with the flashy vibe.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Shoot, I was completely fixated on Craft...!
Uhh, where's that other girl—

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"It's Heart! Daring Heart!
Our ultimate leader♡ Make sure to cheer for her!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text: Ah, u-oss!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I'm glad I came to see it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Those two, radiating such brilliant light――
will become rivals, won't they?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
…………
You're both as strong as expected.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“—I'll join you soon.
On the very same stage as all of you.”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Craft!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—You never disappoint!
You really are the best!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
How do you hit your top speed
so smoothly?!
Are you hiding rocket engines in there or something?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Keep your speed in a good position like that, hold it, hold it... the final straight—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fwoosh!
Surging forward in a single flash...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: H-Heart-san? Um—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You're totally awesome!
The fastest and the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: So—I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the lead at a pace even your speed
can't catch up to.
Holding on, holding on, holding on—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Bye-bye! ♪
And then, I will become—the Queen!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case! Then...!
I'll hone my speed even more!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: The tiara of my dreams—I will claim it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Someone's fired up!
—I'm looking forward to next year!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Daring Heart returned, her eyes—
were burning with anticipation for the future built upon today.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I decided to challenge myself after all!
Experiencing this grand stage made me realize that.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Further down the Tiara route, we'll get into even fiercer clashes...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez... I can't wait!
I'm seriously looking forward to it—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, Oops!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm right as rain...
Feels like the adrenaline just wore off.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...That makes another thing clear.
You're still running purely on emotion,
which means you're not yet perfect.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I know. You will help me grow again, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Heheh, not being able to answer right away is all part of your charm.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now that you've gained a smidge of confidence!
Let's talk about our next goal race.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, keeping on like this...
you'll be stepping up along the path to the Triple Tiara, right?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's what I want to do. Next up is—
Yeah, that's what I want to do. Next—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next year is the Classic year—the Triple Tiara route, our grand goal, approaches.
The first crown is the Oka Sho, but before that—
choice_data_list: One more tune-up in the Fillies' Revue.
One more tune-up in the Fillies' Revue!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "The Fillies' Revue! 1,400 meters... that's the same distance as the Make Debut, right?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: There were other stepping stones to the Oka Sho, like the 1,600m Tulip Sho... What made you choose this one?
choice_data_list: I want to hone my strengths at a familiar distance.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Okay!
Let's evolve the running style we've mastered even further."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the next target race was decided: the Fillies' Revue.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Craft and the other girls...
will surely keep getting stronger. But you see—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll soar right over it!
Gracefully, just like a bird♪
